issues.explanation: Entity creation transaction lives inline in CreateEntity::submit instead of an app/Actions/* use-case class that authorizes inside the action.
Navbar layout queries auth()->user()->memberships()->count() directly in Blade instead of receiving the flag from a controller/composer.
No explicit Livewire unauthorized-call test for CreateEntity::submit as guest nor tamper test for Dashboard locked entity, both required by the Livewire policy definition of done.
Single-membership middleware path dereferences ->entity without null handling, so a soft-deleted sole entity would fatal instead of redirecting or aborting 403.

conventions.evidence: Follows Validate+validate (CreateEntity.php:174-179), authorize in submit/mount/pick (CreateEntity.php:182, Dashboard.php:273, EntityController.php:37), #[Locked] entity (Dashboard.php:268), persistent middleware (AppServiceProvider.php:644), Fillable attributes matching User.php, audit channel logging, docs/CHANGELOG updated; deviation: no app/Actions/* for the entity-creation write, query in navbar view.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:101-135, EntityPolicy.php:572-607), clear names (uniqueSlug, membershipFor, manageable), consistent docblocks, no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: entities soft deletes + slug route binding (Entity.php:307-315, migration 042706:778-784), owner_seq stored column + one-owner unique (migration 042708:819-831), policies match role matrix (EntityPolicy.php:572-607, MembershipPolicy.php:510-538), onboarding transaction + retry on UniqueConstraintViolationException + audit + session + redirect (CreateEntity.php:187-223) with uniqueSlug on every attempt (CreateEntity.php:188,235-247), middleware 0/1/>1 dispatch and 403 (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:108-134), home/pick/switcher/dashboard routes and behavior (web.php:1052-1072, HomeController.php:68-74, EntityController.php:37-46, switcher.blade.php:978-982), lang keys both locales.

scope.evidence: All touched files serve entities/memberships/tenant session/onboarding/switcher/dashboard plus required docs sync (database-schema.md, architecture.md, business-rules.md, CHANGELOG.md); no members/settings pages, locale middleware, dropdown redesign, or unrelated refactors.

security.evidence: Server-side authorization on every write/view (CreateEntity.php:182, Dashboard.php:273, EntityController.php:37, policies), input validated (CreateEntity.php:174-179), mass-assignment via Fillable with fixed Owner role, {{ }} escaping and @csrf in switcher.blade.php:976, #[Locked] Entity model, persistent current_entity middleware; no secrets in public props.

simplicity.evidence: Direct Eloquent reads, small controllers/middleware, reusable x-layouts/x-form-field/x-button and Bulma classes, slug logic minimal with withTrashed check; no service layers or speculative abstractions.

tests.evidence: EntityModelTest.php covers soft deletes, casts, scopes, owner, DB-level one-owner and membership uniqueness, cascade, both policy matrices; EntityOnboardingTest.php covers rendering, validation, owner creation, session redirect, slug increment, insert-time retry, audit log, trashed slug; EntityTenantTest.php covers guests, verified, home dispatch, middleware, foreign 403s, pick session-untouched, switcher filtering/marking, navbar gating; missing Livewire unauthorized submit and locked-entity tamper tests.

review.summary: Implements entities, single-owner constraint, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding with slug retry, switcher, dashboard, and thorough Pest coverage. Approve with nits: extract the creation write to an Action per conventions and add the missing Livewire unauthorized/tamper tests.
